text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking near the training track, I heard 
some kind of commotion.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Big trouble! It's a fight! There's a 
fight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't just leave it alone. Hurrying 
over to check on the situation――

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, look at that spirit! 
Don't let up, both of you—show some 
backbone!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, a dead-even tie in the scuffle, huh? 
Then let's settle this with a rogue race!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Trainer?! Throwing cold water on a 
clash of pride is pretty uncool, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Mm, that's it! Even if it's an impromptu 
race, if you give the word, it's a bona 
fide mock race, ain't it?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's the big deal, stingy? Fires and 
brawls are the flowers of Edo, and mock 
races are the flowers of this academy!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Just own up to it and let 'em race! That's 
the real Edo spirit right there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, one thing led to 
another, and an impromptu mock race 
began――!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Great start! Run brisk and 
sharp, the sun itself is watching over ya!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Go, right there, close in, close in! Hang 
in there on the other side toooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Man, that nose-to-nose duel was one hell 
of a scrap. Just look at those bright, 
refreshed looks on their faces!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This is how Umamusume oughta be. Now, all 
that's left is to wrap it up cleanly...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Right then. How about we wrap this up with 
a nice, classy ceremonial clap!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
We both gave it our all. In honor of that 
fighting spirit, clap your hands, 
everyone! Yo—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Inari One's booming call, the crisp 
clap of a ceremonial hand-clap echoed into 
the blue sky――

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I getcha! Wash away all the bad blood 
clean with a cup of cold tea, eh! Thanks, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey guys, drink this and shake off that 
fatigue!
